case_study_packaging.headline: Women’s health platform captures $716K in annual savings and 3.2× ROI through Treya-led strategic sourcing sprint
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Advantia Health’s rapid, PE-funded expansion left procurement scattered across 40 clinics and two legacy accounting systems. Fragmented purchasing drove inconsistent pricing on everything from billing services to medical supplies, while limited internal bandwidth threatened to stall EBITDA improvement goals set by BlueMountain Capital. The leadership team needed an outside partner to quickly uncover and realize cost-savings without disrupting patient care.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A multi-state women’s health platform’s rapid, PE-funded expansion left procurement scattered across 40 clinics and two legacy accounting systems. Fragmented purchasing drove inconsistent pricing on everything from billing services to medical supplies, while limited internal bandwidth threatened to stall EBITDA improvement goals set by the private equity sponsor. The leadership team needed an outside partner to quickly uncover and realize cost-savings without disrupting patient care.
approach_summary: Analyzed $18.9M in annual spend and isolated $13.7M of addressable cost across 10 clinical and administrative categories
Prioritized high-impact waves and renegotiated Athenahealth RCM fees—from 3.39% to 3.15%—leveraging market benchmarks and retroactive pricing
Ran competitive RFPs and distributor consolidation that shifted Heartland clinics to a single McKesson contract, unlocking 14% savings on medical supplies
Re-engineered sonography staffing by insourcing technologists and supplementing with on-demand recruiters, reducing imaging labor cost by 19%
Standardized IUD purchasing policies (≥5-unit orders) and enrolled clinics in Bayer’s Confidence-in-Coverage program to capture manufacturer discounts and device replacements
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $716,395 in verified, recurring annual savings—exceeding the guaranteed target by 59% and generating a 3.2× return on the $225K fixed project fee. First savings flowed within 60 days, and six of seven initiatives are fully implemented. Beyond hard dollars, Advantia now operates with standardized purchasing policies, consolidated vendor relationships, and clearer spend visibility that supports ongoing margin expansion.
where_we_were_unique: Unlocked quick wins—first dollar savings realized in just 60 days despite decentralized data and limited client resources
Secured meaningful concessions from entrenched incumbents (e.g., Athenahealth) even under restrictive contract terms and high switching costs
Blended clinical and back-office expertise, allowing cost reductions that maintained caregiver workflows and patient experience
Exceeded savings guarantee by 59%, proving Treya’s ability to deliver outsized value against fixed-fee engagements
